title: Annex A.6.2.5 - AI system V&V
description: Targeted working paper for the V&V control: pre-release testing, robustness, fairness, regression suites.

sections.title: V&V plan
prompts: Confirm a V&V plan exists per system version.
Verify acceptance criteria align with stated intended use.

sections.title: Robustness testing
prompts: Confirm adversarial / paraphrase consistency tests for LLMs.
Confirm FGSM/PGD or equivalent for vision systems.

sections.title: Fairness testing
prompts: Verify demographic parity / equalized odds for classifiers where applicable.

suggestedInterviewQuestions: Show us the V&V evidence for the current production model.
How do you select the robustness suites?
